title: Beach Adjacent
author: Moose Flores
problems: The progression after row 8 "balance & box circulate - larks cross while robins loop right · box circulate" doesn't work out: Couple 1 must face the same way to find new neighbors.
choices: A star with no grip named is a basket star (wrist grip).
Long waves form during the balance before each box circulate: crossers face in, loopers face out; hands join only where they reach.
